title: Late-Receipt Load on Interim Deposits (Group Room Blocks)
content:
**Ruling.** The days past due of a Group Room Blocks interim deposit are the whole calendar days from its due date, which is the block type's interim due period of calendar days before the arrival date, to the date it is paid; an interim deposit paid on or before its due date has no days past due. The late-receipt load follows the days past due and is added to the interim percentage:

- days past due **more than 14**: a load of **5** percentage points;
- **at least 1 but no more than 14** days past due: a load of **2.5** percentage points;
- paid by its due date: no load.

### Due dates by block type

| Block type | Interim deposit due (calendar days before arrival) |
|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 90 |
| Wedding Room Block | 120 |
| Sports Team Room Block | 0 |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 0 |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 0 |
| Association Convention Room Block | 0 |

### Worked loads (hypothetical Wedding Room Block, due 120 days before arrival)

| Paid, before arrival | Days past due | Load |
|---|---|---|
| 121 days | none (paid early) | none |
| 120 days | none (paid on the due date) | none |
| 119 days | 1 | 2.5 points |
| 106 days | 14 | 2.5 points |
| 105 days | 15 | 5 points |
| 100 days | 20 | 5 points |
